results.title: Sound Healing with Tuning Fork use in Rehabilitation
results.content: ### Sound Healing with Tuning Fork use in Rehabilitation. Tuning fork therapy in health care has grown over the past two decades; however, this modality has been used in healing for hundreds of years across many cultures. Weighted tuning forks have weights on the ends that amplify the sound and are used directly on the body; unweighted tuning forks are used off the body and do not have the same amplitude or frequency but have a clear, precise sound. Unweighted tuning forks are used for relaxation and meditation and can be effective in quieting the mind. Her information, education, and exploration in treating upper extremity injuries with the use of tuning forks generated my curiosity, further research, and practice with this sound healing modality. There are many ways you can use tuning forks for healing. Sound healing with the use of tuning forks is a safe and effective way to support healing of injuries to the upper limb.
